name: uk-collapse-index
description: A transparent, evidence-audited UK national stability and systemic-pressure monitor.

scripts.migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply collapse-index --local --config wrangler.ingest.jsonc
scripts.migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply collapse-index --remote --config wrangler.ingest.jsonc
scripts.check: npm run lint:syntax && npm test && npm run check:bundle
scripts.check:bundle: wrangler deploy --config wrangler.web.jsonc --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry/web && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.ingest.jsonc --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry/ingest
